issues.description: The feature-specific ghost model is named the overly broad `CpuModel`, even though it contains only the maximum basic leaf and AVX/AVX-512F capability bits.
issues.rationale: The model does not represent the CPU generally: it records only `max_basic_leaf`, `avx_bit`, and `avx512f_bit`, and its methods expose only those two enumerated features. The collaborator explicitly recommends `CpuFeatureModel` because `CpuModel` overstates the abstraction's scope. This matches `name-proof-roles`, which rejects broad type names when the type represents a narrower state or role. A feature-specific name also prevents future unrelated CPU state or enablement assumptions from being silently folded into this small trusted capability model.
issues.source_evidence:

37:     /// CPUID.(1, 0):ECX[28], meaningful only when leaf 1 is supported.
38:     pub avx_bit: bool,
39:     /// CPUID.(7, 0):EBX[16], meaningful only when leaf 7 is supported.
